a.v: An expense claim covers a cost you pay on someone else's behalf. You spend your own money on something the guild is going to pay for, and you are reimbursed afterwards.

items.q: Do I always get my money back?

a.v: No, not automatically. You are reimbursed when the purchase is reported with a valid receipt and has been attested by someone with attest rights for it.

A purchase without attest is paid for by whoever made it. For an out-of-pocket expense you are not reimbursed, and for a guild card purchase you are invoiced for the amount. The treasurer can decide in an individual case that reimbursement is paid anyway, or that no invoice is sent.
An out-of-pocket expense must also be reported within 60 days, or it can be refused.

items.q: What should I do before I buy something?

v: Check the purchase with your result owner if you can. They are the one who attests it afterwards, and a purchase that is not attested is yours to pay for.
Use the guild card if you have one, so you do not have to lay out your own money.
Make sure you get a valid receipt at the till, not just an order confirmation or a card terminal slip.
Report the purchase here in the app as soon as you are home.

items.q: Is there money in the budget for the purchase?

a.v: There should be. A cost item in the budget may not be exceeded without the budget being adjusted first. If the item the purchase belongs to does not have enough, a budget change is needed before the purchase is made, and it is approved by the treasurer.
More on how that works under Budget.
